glorious - model o eternal lightweight w.description: The Model O Eternal ultralight RGB gaming mouse takes our award-winning Model O’s iconic shape, speed, and precision, and bundles it into a sleek package eternally ready for action. Its symmetrical design ensures a natural, secure grip—whether you’re gaming or just getting things done. With 6 remappable buttons, assign your go-to equipment, abilities, and shortcuts exactly where they feel right. At just 55g (up to 35% lighter than the competition), the Model O Eternal ditches the deadweight, letting you swipe and stop quicker and more precisely. Its honeycomb design cuts weight without sacrificing comfort or durability—because who needs extra grams holding them back? Rocking more than just a glowing logo, the Model O Eternal lights up with vibrant RGB on its flared side panels, customizable to match your setup’s vibe. Built to last, it features 80-million-click switches—no premature double-clicking here—and a 12K DPI optical sensor that tracks even your fastest flicks. Miss your mark? Don’t blame the sensor. With a 100-12,000 DPI range, dialing in sensitivity is a breeze. Ready for action, the Model O Eternal keeps you at the top of your game, no excuses.
